name: database
// targets: to see all targets run: nx show project database --web

reset-e2e.// purpose: Clears the e2e target month and widens the reservation window; see the script's own docs. `apps/garage/web-e2e`'s globalSetup runs the same file directly (one `node` process instead of an Nx invocation inside a test run); this target is the discoverable way to run it by hand.

prisma-generate.// inputs: `default` first, deliberately: naming only the schema file **replaced** the default input set instead of extending it, so nothing but that one file could invalidate the cached client. The `externalDependencies` entry is the other half — a Prisma version bump changes the generated client and must miss the cache. Final review M-5.

check-schema.// purpose: The guard `schema.prisma` did not have. Both parity suites compare artefacts *derived* from it — `schema-contract-parity.spec.ts` reads the committed generated client, `migration-sql.spec.ts` reads the migration SQL — so an edit to the schema with no `prisma generate` and no migration left both of them passing against stale inputs. Final review I-3. Needs a live PostgreSQL (`docker compose --profile dev up -d`) and `DATABASE_URL`; it is not part of `nx run-many -t lint,typecheck,test,build` for that reason, and belongs in CI's `database` job, which already has the service.
